ONE ARCHIVAL CARD, OWNING ALL THREE RECORDS THIS ACT WROTE, RUNNING ALONE. A review_plan is required on the handoff that OPENS a claim-changing review round. This card opens none: an archival commit is not a claim-relevant producer, and the decision it archives moves no hypothesis, composes no evidence, closes no lane and asserts no claim.

tasks.handoff_inline_note: The handoff is INLINED above because tools/research_dispatch.py validate_handoff requires tasks[].handoff to be an object and never reads handoff_record; a path pointer is not a supported alternative. handoff_record is retained beside it as the pointer to the canonical YAML card. The two must not drift: ledger/handoffs/TASK-20260922-9f6b02.yaml is the record that gets committed and is authoritative for anything not represented here, notably archive_kind_note, budget_basis, read_scope, write_scope_exclusivity and the full dispatch_preconditions_note. RECONCILED BEFORE DISPATCH: a discrepancy flagged here earlier -- the ledger record's deliverables/completion_gate still describing only the two artifact_paths plus the also_staged path, with no mention of TASK-20260922-ce7325's source artifact -- was corrected in place in the still-uncommitted ledger record before any commit, so the two now agree. The commit carries three distinct categories of path: the two artifact_paths this card owns and hash-binds; one source artifact (ledger/handoffs/TASK-20260922-ce7325.yaml), reached through archive.source_task_ids and hash-bound but not written by this card; and one also-staged path (this queue), committed but not hash-bound for the fixed-point reason in queue_note. The inference blocks were reconciled the same way: fallback_allowed is true, with the same fallback_reason, in both inference blocks here and on the ledger record.
tasks.completion_gate_note: The gate is inlined in handoff.completion_gate above and is carried in the same wording on ledger/handoffs/TASK-20260922-9f6b02.yaml. Its load-bearing clauses: the commit changes exactly the two declared artifact_paths, the one source artifact path from TASK-20260922-ce7325, and the one also_staged path, and does not touch the ICPERF goal head; every declared and source sha256 matches the committed tree; validate_ledger reports no error attributable to any of the three files and the total has not risen above 94; the post-commit verifier ACCEPTS; and the branch is pushed with a PR naming all three records. WHICH CLAUSE IS CHECKED BY WHOM: under archive.binding_mode content_at_commit the post-commit verifier (tools/research_dispatch.py verify_archive) checks reachability, the declared parent, that path_sha256 covers exactly the two artifact_paths plus the one source artifact, that those hashes match the bytes at the archive commit, and that the commit message names this task and every record_id. It does NOT compare the commit's changed-path set; that comparison runs only under binding_mode commit. The 'changes EXACTLY' clause is therefore checked by the archiving session itself, from git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-status -r <commit_sha>, and that output is reported with the receipt. Verifier acceptance alone does not satisfy it.

archive.source_task_ids_note: TASK-20260922-ce7325, the Coordinator ranking-and-intake-refusal act that produced DEC-20260922-10272e. A CORRECTION from the single self-referential card this queue originally carried: that card named itself as its own archive.source_task_ids, which tools/research_dispatch.py:912 (validate_queue) refuses -- 'archive task may only archive non-archive source tasks' -- because is_archive(source) is true for any card carrying an archive block, itself included. The self-reference was reaching honestly for 'this ranking act had no queued producer card,' the same gap BATCH-94168f's own notes name elsewhere. The fix is not to relax the check but to supply the honest producer, following the two-card precedent in coordination/2026-09-05-ecc-ideas-integrity-972e08/dispatch_queue.json (TASK-20260905-c81c06 producer / TASK-20260905-b2b87f archive). TASK-20260922-ce7325 is that producer: a completed, zero-run Coordinator record of the act, added under a pre-allocated, --check-verified identifier, with write_scope disjoint from this archive card's. Read this field as 'produced by TASK-20260922-ce7325', not as a second task that independently ran anything -- the decision's content did not change.
archive.binding_mode_note: content_at_commit: the receipt binds the declared path hashes verified against the tree at its own commit, so the archive's validity does not depend on the repository's merge strategy -- which is what N concurrent worktrees require.
